literal: All overdue debts from before the nineteenth year are completely remitted in the original amount.
idiomatic: All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year were remitted in full.

literal: Where there was failure of harvest last year, assess by category and report reductions.
idiomatic: Where the harvest failed last year, reductions were to be assessed by category and reported.

literal: In places of extreme abuse and hardship, envoys were sent to the commanderies and counties to grant relief as appropriate.
idiomatic: In districts suffering the worst hardship, envoys were sent to the commanderies and counties to provide relief as local conditions required.

literal: All who wished to attach to agriculture but lacked sowing grain were additionally granted loans.
idiomatic: All who wished to return to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally granted loans.

literal: Corvée workers of the thousand-mou camps and their supervising offices were granted cloth in differing amounts.
idiomatic: Corvée workers of the thousand-mou camps and their supervising offices received grants of cloth in varying amounts.

literal: On the wu-wu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, died.
idiomatic: On the wu-wu day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, died.

literal: On the hsin-yu day, Liu Yizong, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Governor of Southern Yen Province.
idiomatic: On the hsin-yu day, Liu Yizong, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Governor of Southern Yen Province.

literal: In the second month, on the keng-wu day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was made Governor of Yu Province.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the keng-wu day, Zhao Bofu, General Who Leads the Army, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

literal: On the chi-chou day, Prince of Chiang-hsia Yikung, Minister of Works and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, was advanced to Grand Marshal and retained the post of Minister over the Masses.
idiomatic: On the chi-chou day, Prince of Chiang-hsia Yikung, Minister of Works and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, was promoted to Grand Marshal while retaining the post of Minister over the Masses.

literal: On the keng-yin day, Shen Yen-chih, General of the Right Guard, was made General Who Leads the Army in the Interior.
idiomatic: On the keng-yin day, Shen Yen-chih, General of the Right Guard, was appointed General Who Leads the Army in the Interior.

literal: On the hsin-mao day, the seventh imperial son Hung was established as Prince of Chien-p'ing.
idiomatic: On the hsin-mao day, the seventh imperial son Hung was created Prince of Chien-p'ing.

literal: On the chia-wu day, Prince of Kuang-ling Tan was made Governor of Southern Yen Province.
idiomatic: On the chia-wu day, Prince of Kuang-ling Tan was appointed Governor of Southern Yen Province.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, Hsu Keng of Yen-ling in Chin-ling commandery presented a thousand hu of rice to aid famine victims.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Hsu Keng of Yen-ling in Chin-ling commandery presented a thousand hu of rice to relieve the famine-stricken.

literal: On the jen-hsü day of the fifth month, Ho Shang-chih of the Masters of Writing was made General of the Central Guard; Liu Tao-hsi, Consulting Colonel, was made Governor of Kuang Province.
idiomatic: On the jen-hsü day of the fifth month, Ho Shang-chih of the Masters of Writing was appointed General of the Central Guard, and Liu Tao-hsi, Consulting Colonel, became Governor of Kuang Province.

literal: In the sixth month, rain fell continuously.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain fell without cease.

literal: On the ting-hai day, an edict said: "For days on end the steady rains have brought flooding; the people, long frugal, are easily driven to want.
idiomatic: On the ting-hai day, an edict said: "For days on end the steady rains have brought flooding; the people, long accustomed to frugality, are easily driven to destitution.

literal: The magistrates of the two counties and the supervising offices of the camps and garrisons shall each, according to their jurisdiction, inspect and verify, and supply fuel and grain, making certain that nothing is left wanting."
idiomatic: The magistrates of the two counties and the supervising offices of the camps and garrisons shall each, within their jurisdiction, inspect and verify the need, and supply fuel and grain, ensuring that nothing is left wanting."

literal: On the ting-yu day of the seventh month of autumn, Prince of Shih-hsing Chun, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally made General of the Central Army; Prince of Wu-ling Chun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army.
idiomatic: On the ting-yu day of the seventh month of autumn, Prince of Shih-hsing Chun, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally appointed General of the Central Army; Prince of Wu-ling Chun, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.

literal: On the i-ssu day, an edict said: "In recent years the grain harvest has been injured, and excessive drought has become a calamity—this is also because the suitability of planting has not yet been fully observed.
idiomatic: On the i-ssu day, an edict said: "In recent years the grain harvest has suffered, and excessive drought has become a calamity—this is also because suitable planting has not yet been fully pursued.

literal: Southern Hsu, Yen, Yu, and the commanderies west of the Che River belonging to Yang Province—from now on all are to be supervised in planting wheat, to help supply what is lacking.
idiomatic: Southern Hsu, Yen, Yu, and the commanderies west of the Che River in Yang Province—from now on are all to be supervised in planting wheat, to help make up what is lacking.

literal: Quickly transport the wheat seed on hand in P'eng-ch'eng and Hsia-p'ei commanderies and entrust it to the inspectors for distribution as loans.
idiomatic: Wheat seed on hand in P'eng-ch'eng and Hsia-p'ei commanderies is to be transported promptly and entrusted to the inspectors for distribution as loans.

literal: Hsu and Yu have much paddy land, yet among the people exclusive attention is given to dry-field cultivation; orders are to be sent to the two defense commands to follow the old embankments, jointly repair and establish them, and moreover assign reclamation, that it may be ready by next year.
idiomatic: Hsu and Yu have abundant paddy land, yet the people devote themselves chiefly to dry-field cultivation; orders are to be sent to the two defense commands to follow the old embankments, jointly repair and restore them, and moreover assign reclamation so that it may be ready by the coming year.

literal: In all provinces and commanderies, let every advantage of the land be fully exploited; encourage planting—silkworms, mulberry, hemp, and ramie—each in its proper way; one must not merely carry out documents on paper."
idiomatic: In every province and commandery, let the land's advantages be fully exploited; encourage planting—silkworms, mulberry, hemp, and ramie—each in its proper season; officials must not merely go through the motions of written orders."

literal: On the wu-ch'en day of the eighth month, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Ching Province, was made General Who Campaigns North, with privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Southern Yen Province; Prince of Nan-ch'iao Yihsuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsu Province, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Ching Province.
idiomatic: On the wu-ch'en day of the eighth month, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Ching Province, became General Who Campaigns North, with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Southern Yen Province; Prince of Nan-ch'iao Yihsuan, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Hsu Province, became General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Ching Province.

literal: [31] Prince of Kuang-ling Tan, Governor of Southern Yen Province, was made Governor of Southern Hsu Province.
idiomatic: [31] Prince of Kuang-ling Tan, Governor of Southern Yen Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Hsu Province.

literal: On the chia-ch'en day of the ninth month, the Great Ju-ch'ü An-chou was made General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as King of Ho-hsi.
idiomatic: On the chia-ch'en day of the ninth month, the Great Ju-ch'ü An-chou was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Governor of Liang Province and enfeoffed as King of Ho-hsi.

literal: On the chi-mao day in the tenth month of winter, Hsu Ch'iung, General of the Left Army, was made Governor of Yen Province; Shen T'ien, Staff Officer of the Grand General, was made Governor of Chi Province.
idiomatic: On the chi-mao day in the tenth month of winter, Hsu Ch'iung, General of the Left Army, was appointed Governor of Yen Province; Shen T'ien, Staff Officer of the Grand General, was appointed Governor of Chi Province.

literal: On the hsin-mao day, the first of the first month of spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuankang new calendar of Ho Ch'eng-t'ien, Censor-in-Chief, was adopted.
idiomatic: On the hsin-mao day, the first of the first month of spring of the twenty-second year, the Yuankang new calendar of Censor-in-Chief Ho Ch'eng-t'ien was adopted.

literal: On the jen-ch'en day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was changed to Governor of Yung Province; Prince of Nan-p'ing Shuo, Governor of Hsiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the jen-ch'en day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was reassigned as Governor of Yung Province; Prince of Nan-p'ing Shuo, Governor of Hsiang Province, became Governor of Southern Yu Province.

literal: On the hsin-ssu day of the second month, Wang Seng-lang, Attendant, was made Governor of Hsiang Province.
idiomatic: On the hsin-ssu day of the second month, Wang Seng-lang, Attendant, was appointed Governor of Hsiang Province.

literal: On the chia-hsü day, the eighth imperial son Hui was established as Prince of Tung-hai, and the ninth imperial son Ch'ang as Prince of I-yang.
idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day, the eighth imperial son Hui was created Prince of Tung-hai, and the ninth imperial son Ch'ang was created Prince of I-yang.

literal: On the hsin-hai day of the sixth month in summer, Prince of Nan-p'ing Shuo, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was made Governor of Yu Province.
idiomatic: On the hsin-hai day of the sixth month in summer, Prince of Nan-p'ing Shuo, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

literal: On the chi-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Yen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Ho Shang-chih, General of the Central Guard, was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the chi-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, Meng Yen, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Ho Shang-chih, General of the Central Guard, became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Prince of Wu-ling Chun, Governor of Yung Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and moved more than fourteen thousand households to the capital.
idiomatic: Prince of Wu-ling Chun, Governor of Yung Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and resettled more than fourteen thousand households in the capital.

literal: On the i-yu day, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was changed to Governor of Hsu Province.
idiomatic: On the i-yu day, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Southern Yen Province, was reassigned as Governor of Hsu Province.

literal: On the chi-wei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
idiomatic: On the chi-wei day of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand ch'ing of abandoned fields at Hu-shu were brought back into cultivation.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand ch'ing of abandoned fields at Hu-shu were brought back into cultivation.

literal: On the i-wei day of the twelfth month, Fan Yeh, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all executed.
idiomatic: On the i-wei day of the twelfth month, Fan Yeh, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, plotted rebellion; he and his accomplices were all put to death.

literal: On the ting-yu day, Prince of P'eng-ch'eng Yik'ang, Grand General, was removed and made a commoner.
idiomatic: On the ting-yu day, Prince of P'eng-ch'eng Yik'ang, Grand General, was stripped of rank and reduced to commoner status.

literal: On the keng-hsü day, Chao Po-fu, former Governor of Yu Province, was made General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the keng-hsü day, Chao Po-fu, former Governor of Yu Province, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: On the ting-ssu day of the first month of spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Ch'ang-sha, was made Governor of Yi Province.
idiomatic: On the ting-ssu day of the first month of spring of the twenty-third year, Lu Hui, Administrator of Ch'ang-sha, was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

literal: On the keng-shên day, Meng Yen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, left office.
idiomatic: On the keng-shên day, Meng Yen, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, left office.

literal: Han River refugees were moved and settled along the Han.
idiomatic: Refugees from the Han River region were resettled along the Han.

literal: On the kuei-mao day of the second month, Liu Yipin, General of the Left Guard, was made Governor of Southern Yen Province.
idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day of the second month, Liu Yipin, General of the Left Guard, was appointed Governor of Southern Yen Province.

literal: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yen and Yu provinces; Shen T'ien, Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces, defeated them.
idiomatic: In the third month, the Suolu raided Yen and Yu provinces; Shen T'ien, Governor of Ch'ing and Chi provinces, defeated them.

literal: On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the ting-wei day of the fourth month in summer, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: On the kuei-wei day, the first of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
idiomatic: On the kuei-wei day, the first of the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: Tan Ho-chih, Governor of Chiao Province, attacked the state of Lin-yi and captured it.
idiomatic: Tan Ho-chih, Governor of Chiao Province, attacked the state of Lin-yi and captured it.

literal: On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, Tu T'an, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, was made Governor of Ch'ing Province.
idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day of the seventh month in autumn, Tu T'an, Gentleman Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Ch'ing Province.

literal: On the kuei-mao day of the eighth month, the ochre rebels of Chieh-yang attacked Chien-an commandery and burned the government offices.
idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day of the eighth month, the ochre rebels of Chieh-yang attacked Chien-an commandery and burned the government offices.

literal: On the chi-mao day of the ninth month, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy; the students were examined by question and answer, fifty-nine persons in all.
idiomatic: On the chi-mao day of the ninth month, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy; the students were examined in question and answer, fifty-nine in all.

literal: On the wu-tzu day in the tenth month of winter, an edict said: "The schools have been established for many years, and the sons of officials have completed their studies.
idiomatic: On the wu-tzu day in the tenth month of winter, an edict said: "The schools have stood for many years, and the sons of officials have completed their studies.

literal: Having recently witnessed them in close examination, I beheld their flourishing excellence and, gazing back to Chu and Ssu, ever cherish the past.
idiomatic: Having recently examined them at close hand, I beheld their flourishing excellence and, looking back to the age of Chu and Ssu, cherish the past.

literal: The students' answers to questions are in large part fit to be read.
idiomatic: The students' answers are for the most part fit to be read with profit.

literal: The instructors are all to receive rewards.
idiomatic: Their instructors are all to receive rewards.

literal: " Silk was granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: " Silk was granted in varying amounts.

literal: On the ting-yu day of the twelfth month, Hsiao Ching-hsien, Marshal of Dragon Celerity, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
idiomatic: On the ting-yu day of the twelfth month, Hsiao Ching-hsien, Marshal of Dragon Celerity, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

literal: That year, the harvest was greatly abundant.
idiomatic: That year brought a great harvest.

literal: The northern embankment was built, Hsuan-wu Lake was established, and Ching-yang Mountain was constructed in the Hua-lin Park.
idiomatic: The northern embankment was built, Hsuan-wu Lake was established, and Ching-yang Mountain was raised in the Hua-lin Park.

literal: On the chia-hsü day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.

literal: Imprisoned convicts were pardoned with reduced sentences; all overdue obligations were leniently reduced in differing amounts.
idiomatic: Imprisoned convicts received reduced sentences; all overdue obligations were leniently reduced in varying amounts.

literal: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.
idiomatic: The elderly living alone and those afflicted with the six infirmities who could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

literal: Half of this year's land tax for Chien-k'ang and Mu-ling counties was remitted.
idiomatic: Half of this year's land tax for Chien-k'ang and Mu-ling counties was remitted.

literal: On the jen-shên day of the third month, Chao Po-fu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred to another post.
idiomatic: On the jen-shên day of the third month, Chao Po-fu, General Who Protects the Army, was transferred to another post.

literal: On the chia-hsü day of the fifth month in summer, Tu T'an, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally made Governor of Chi Province.
idiomatic: On the chia-hsü day of the fifth month in summer, Tu T'an, Governor of Ch'ing Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Chi Province.

literal: In the sixth month, pestilence struck the capital; on the ping-hsü day, the commanderies, counties, and supervising offices of the camps and garrisons were all ordered to tour widely and supply medicine.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, pestilence struck the capital; on the ping-hsü day, the commanderies, counties, and supervising offices of the camps and garrisons were ordered to tour widely and supply medicine.

literal: That month, because goods were dear, large coins were instituted at the value of two.
idiomatic: That month, because goods were dear, large coins were instituted at a value of two.

literal: On the i-mao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as rewards in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On the i-mao day of the seventh month in autumn, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Lin-yi were distributed as rewards in varying amounts.

literal: On the i-wei day of the eighth month, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Hsu Province, died.
idiomatic: On the i-wei day of the eighth month, Prince of Heng-yang Yichi, General Who Campaigns North and Governor of Hsu Province, died.

literal: On the kuei-mao day, Liu Yipin, Governor of Southern Yen Province, was made Governor of Hsu Province.
idiomatic: On the kuei-mao day, Liu Yipin, Governor of Southern Yen Province, was appointed Governor of Hsu Province.

literal: On the chi-wei day of the ninth month, Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army in the Interior, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the chi-wei day of the ninth month, Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army in the Interior, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the hsin-wei day, Hsu Chan-chih, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was made Governor of Southern Yen Province.
idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day, Hsu Chan-chih, Grandee Tutor of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Governor of Southern Yen Province.

literal: On the jen-wu day in the tenth month of winter, Hu Tan-shih of Yu-chang rebelled and killed the Administrator Huan Lung-chih; Tan Ho-chih, former Governor of Chiao Province, returning south reached Yu-chang and thereupon suppressed the rebellion.
idiomatic: On the jen-wu day in the tenth month of winter, Hu Tan-shih of Yu-chang rebelled and killed the Administrator Huan Lung-chih; Tan Ho-chih, former Governor of Chiao Province, on his return south reached Yu-chang and thereupon suppressed the rebellion.

literal: On the jen-ch'en day, Prince of Chien-p'ing Hung was made General of the Central Guard.
idiomatic: On the jen-ch'en day, Prince of Chien-p'ing Hung was appointed General of the Central Guard.

literal: On the chia-yin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was established as Prince of Ju-yin.
idiomatic: On the chia-yin day of the eleventh month, the tenth imperial son Hun was created Prince of Ju-yin.

literal: On the wu-ch'en day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow have lasted for ten days; fuel and grain have soared in price, and poor and destitute households are in many cases reduced to utter want.
idiomatic: On the wu-ch'en day of the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow have lasted ten days on end; fuel and grain have soared in price, and poor and destitute households are in many cases reduced to utter want.

literal: Let the two capital counties and the camps and garrisons be inspected, and fuel and grain granted."
idiomatic: Let the two capital counties and the camps and garrisons be inspected, and fuel and grain granted."

literal: On the keng-yin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one must not forget peril—this is what governs the age;
idiomatic: On the keng-yin day of the second month, an edict said: "In security one must not forget peril—this is what governs the age;

literal: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.
idiomatic: to train the army and teach warfare is the constant statute of a state.

literal: Therefore, having received instruction and knowing shame, young and old alike learn restraint.
idiomatic: Therefore, having received instruction and knowing shame, young and old alike learn restraint.

literal: Recently military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet the commands have not been made clear.
idiomatic: Recently military affairs have indeed been cultivated, yet the commands have not been made clear.

literal: Now that the Hsuan-wu training ground has been completed, a great review of the armies may be set for a fixed day.
idiomatic: Now that the Hsuan-wu training ground has been completed, a great review of the armies may be set for a fixed day.

literal: It shall take place in conjunction with the hunt review, to drill the troops and discuss affairs of war."
idiomatic: It shall take place in conjunction with the hunt review, to drill the troops and discuss affairs of war."

literal: On the chi-yu day of the intercalary month, a grand hunt was held at the Hsuan-wu training ground.
idiomatic: On the chi-yu day of the intercalary month, a grand hunt was held at the Hsuan-wu training ground.

literal: On the keng-ch'en day of the third month, the imperial carriage conducted a hunt review.
idiomatic: On the keng-ch'en day of the third month, the emperor conducted a hunt review.

literal: On the i-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, the new Ch'ang-k'o and Kuang-mo gates were built; the former Kuang-mo gate was renamed Ch'eng-ming, and K'ai-yang was renamed Chin-yang.
idiomatic: On the i-ssu day of the fourth month in summer, the new Ch'ang-k'o and Kuang-mo gates were built; the former Kuang-mo gate was renamed Ch'eng-ming, and K'ai-yang was renamed Chin-yang.

literal: On the i-mao day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yung Province, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province.
idiomatic: On the i-mao day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yung Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province.

literal: On the kuei-hai day, Hsiao Ssu-hua, General of the Right Guard, was made Governor of Yung Province.
idiomatic: On the kuei-hai day, Hsiao Ssu-hua, General of the Right Guard, was appointed Governor of Yung Province.

literal: On the chi-mao day of the fifth month, large coins at the value of two were abolished.
idiomatic: On the chi-mao day of the fifth month, large coins at a value of two were abolished.

literal: On the keng-hsü day of the sixth month, Ssu-ma Yüan-yü, Marshal of Ling-ling, died.
idiomatic: On the keng-hsü day of the sixth month, Ssu-ma Yüan-yü, Marshal of Ling-ling, died.

literal: On the keng-shên day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province, was additionally made Governor of Yen Province.
idiomatic: On the keng-shên day, Prince of Wu-ling Chun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Hsu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yen Province.

literal: On the ping-yin day, Prince of Nan-ch'iao Yihsuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Ching Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.
idiomatic: On the ping-yin day, Prince of Nan-ch'iao Yihsuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Ching Province, was promoted to Minister of Works.

literal: On the jen-wu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Ching-hung, Grandee of the Left with the Golden Tassel, died.
idiomatic: On the jen-wu day of the seventh month in autumn, Wang Ching-hung, Grandee of the Left with the Golden Tassel, died.

literal: On the chi-yu day of the eighth month, Liu Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the Army, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.
idiomatic: On the chi-yu day of the eighth month, Liu Hsiu-chih, Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the Army, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Ch'in provinces.

literal: On the chia-tzu day, the eleventh imperial son Yü was established as Prince of Huai-yang.
idiomatic: On the chia-tzu day, the eleventh imperial son Yü was created Prince of Huai-yang.

literal: On the hsin-wei day of the ninth month, Ho Shang-chih, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; Liu Tsun-k'ao, Administrator of Wu-hsing, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the hsin-wei day of the ninth month, Ho Shang-chih, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Shen Yen-chih, General Who Leads the Army, was transferred to another post; and Liu Tsun-k'ao, Administrator of Wu-hsing, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the hsin-ssu day of the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
idiomatic: On the hsin-ssu day of the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, the emperor personally sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

literal: On the chi-hai day of the second month, the imperial carriage went by land to Tan-tu and visited the imperial tombs at Ching.
idiomatic: On the chi-hai day of the second month, the emperor traveled overland to Tan-tu and visited the imperial tombs at Ching.

literal: On the ting-ssu day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "I have been apart from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be near at hand, I have had no path by which to gaze upon the road.
idiomatic: On the ting-ssu day of the third month, [34] an edict said: "I have been apart from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is said to be close at hand, I have had no way to look upon the road thither.
